title: The Chump
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael struggles with the fallout of his affair with Donna, facing both personal and professional challenges. Meanwhile, Dwight and Angela navigate a complicated childrearing contract and attempt mediation to settle their dispute. The office dynamics are marked by Michael's crude humor, Pam and Erin's supportive efforts, and tensions arising from infidelity and contractual disagreements. Michael ultimately breaks up with Donna, feeling conflicted but resolved, while other characters react to the unfolding drama with a mix of concern and humor.
